goal: Restore explicit candidate variant application and draft-confirmed gear enhancements in the active Taro gear detail route.
userValue: Players can inspect a returned candidate and its legal variant before explicitly applying it, then edit gear enhancements as a cancellable local draft that changes committed gear only after confirmation.
nonGoals: Do not add a Resolver-selectable action for craftedStatOptions without a resolver-owned identifier.
Do not change target-only geometry, the eight outer regions, sixteen slots, or the locked outer-page scroll contract.
Do not change backend, PostgreSQL, public payload, resolver ownership, legacy page behavior, or the user's unrelated project config.

currentTruth.factOwner: The canonical Resolver owns legal candidate and enhancement validation; Taro owns only local drafts and rendering of verified snapshots.

mustChange: The active Taro gear-detail route restores candidate variant drafts that require an explicit apply action before an equipped slot changes.
The active Taro gear-detail route restores cancellable enhancement drafts that require an explicit confirm action before committed enhancements change.
The current UI interaction, selected-control, truth-adaptation, and component contracts freeze those behaviors and their fail-closed boundaries.
mustNotChange: The legacy page pages/builds/detail.js remains unchanged.
The user's unrelated apps/mini-taro/project.config.json remains unchanged.
riskUnknown: A crafted-stat field without a resolver-owned identifier must remain display-only and fail closed rather than becoming a selectable action.
A Resolve failure, stale response, or revision conflict must not make an unverified draft appear committed.
evidenceRequired: Targeted Vitest coverage for candidate application and enhancement confirmation behavior.
UI architecture audit for the active Taro owner contracts.
Exact candidate-head WeChat smoke for the active gear detail route.

ownership.factOwner: The canonical Resolver owns legal candidate and enhancement validation; the active Taro route owns local edit drafts and renders only current verified snapshots.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change is limited to the active Taro gear editor and its current UI contracts, with draft-only mutations, canonical Resolve as the commit boundary, targeted Vitest, the UI architecture audit, exact candidate-head WeChat smoke and code rollback.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted Vitest proves candidate selection remains a local draft until explicit apply and enhancement edits remain a local draft until explicit confirmation.
The UI architecture audit proves the active Taro and design-system owners publish one canonical gear-detail interaction and executable selected-state grouping.
Exact candidate-head WeChat smoke exercises a multi-variant item, a no-variant item and multi-socket enhancement editing without changing target geometry.
The user explicitly accepts gear_candidate_variant_apply and gear_enhancement_confirm before merge.

decisionLog.decision: The confirmed design requires candidate and returned-variant choices to remain local drafts until explicit apply resolves through the canonical Resolver.
The confirmed design requires gem, enchant and embellishment edits to remain cancellable local drafts until explicit confirmation resolves through the canonical Resolver.
craftedStatOptions without a resolver-owned identifier remain display-only and cannot become a selectable or submitted intent.
